name: RNA copier
oneLine: An RNA that copies other RNA, one letter at a time.
howItWorks: The copier reads a template strand. It lines up matching letters and links them. The new strand is a mirror copy of the old one.
deeper: Labs have evolved ribozymes that copy long RNA strands, but none yet copies itself fully. Whether such a copier ever arose in nature is unknown.
sizeComparison: a 10,000th the width of a hair
simplification: Our copier works far better than any known real one.
